message.content:
ISOLATED GIT WORKTREE of /workspace/SuperGrok1.5 — you MAY edit committed kernel source (csrc/fused/sm_90/). Build/run/debug freely on the 8 H100s. GOAL: fix the 3 bugs that crash the one-model-across-8 flagship decoder run on the in-kernel device-NVSHMEM TP path, so it trains correctly across 8 GPUs.
CONTEXT (validated): the NVSHMEM transport + bring-up + launcher sym-heap + ParTP8 codegen all WORK (8-GPU all-reduce smoke bit-exact). The crash is in the megakernel TP DATA PATH, only exercised when the device NvshmemTransport drives the real flagship megakernel (d=1600/L48). compute-sanitizer log: /tmp/claude-0/-/6354dc07-b50f-40a0-8748-5189102539d3/scratchpad/san_rank0.log (87 invalid 4-byte global writes in fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<AdamW,ParConfig<8,8,1,1,Z3>>+0x1dc30, wild ptr ~35GiB below the NVSHMEM heap). Re-run wiring (non-committed, reuse it): tuning/_tp8_scratch_pybind.cu (calls the launcher tp_size=8 arm), tuning/_tp8_build.sh (the manual -rdc -dlink build torch JIT omits), tuning/_tp8_run.py (the torchrun driver). NVSHMEM_HOME=/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/nvidia/nvshmem; export NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NVLS=1 NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0.
THE 3 BUGS TO FIX (in csrc/fused/sm_90/{model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh, fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh, mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu}):
(A) PER-RANK WEIGHT SHARD OFFSET (the correctness bug): dectc_wbf_convert + dec_bind read the FULL weight matrices with full kDecOffsets identically on every rank — comm.tp_rank is never used. For the column/row-parallel TP GEMMs, each rank must cache/use ITS shard: for column-parallel weights (in_proj 3d, ff0 dff) rank r owns columns [r*Nout/P,(r+1)*Nout/P); for row-parallel (out_proj, ff2) rank r owns the input-rows slice [r*Kin/P,...]. Thread comm.tp_rank/tp_size into the wbf cache + the GEMM source pointers so each rank computes its DISTINCT partial (then the existing in-kernel all-reduce sums the full-width result correctly). This is what the tp_layer.cuh helpers expect (a rank-distinct Wshard ptr).
(B) ATTENTION at kHeads%TP!=0: flagship kHeads=25, TP=8. The simplest CORRECT fix: on the kTPComm path run attention FULL-WIDTH REPLICATED (each rank computes all 25 heads from the full qkv — the head-shard is a memory optimization, not required for correctness; the out_proj all-reduce already recombines). Make the kTPComm attention call the SAME full-width attention as SingleGPU (Hloc=kHeads, Dloc=kD), NOT the partial Hloc=kHeads/TP path, when kHeads%TP!=0 (or just always full-width on kTPComm for now). This removes the Dloc==Hloc*kDhead invariant violation. NOTE: if attention is full-width, the in_proj for attention must NOT be column-sharded the way (A) shards ff — keep the attention qkv full-width (replicated) and only TP-shard the FFN weights + out_proj; reconcile (A) so attention weights stay full and only ff0/ff2 + out_proj shard. Be careful + consistent.
(C) THE IMA is most likely a consequence of (A)/(B) (wrong offsets / inconsistent widths writing out of bounds). After fixing A+B, re-run under compute-sanitizer and confirm 0 errors; if a distinct IMA remains, debug it (the +0x1dc30 offset, the dW/acts/heap indexing on the kTPComm path).
GATES (MANDATORY): (1) decoder pytest CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 GATE_SEED=42 python -m pytest tests/hw/test_decoder_tc.py -q -> 19/19 (your kTPComm edits MUST be if-constexpr(Par::kTPComm)-gated so SingleGPU is byte-identical). (2) the 8-GPU run (tuning/_tp8_run.py via torchrun --nproc_per_node=8): compute-sanitizer CLEAN, all 8 ranks same loss (cross_rank_agree), loss DESCENDS over ~20 steps. Commit your committed-source fixes (git add -A && git commit -m "fix: megakernel TP data-path (per-rank weight shard + full-width attn on kTPComm)"), report sha. BE HONEST if a bug resists — scope it precisely. gfx942/tpu untouched.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Manual build of the TP8 scratch pybind WITH the device-link (-dlink) step torch's
3	# JIT load() omits for -rdc=true objects. Produces sg_tp8_scratch.so with the RDC
4	# registration stub resolved + libnvshmem_device.a device symbols pulled.
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	NVSHMEM_HOME=${NVSHMEM_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/nvidia/nvshmem}
8	BD=${SG_TORCH_EXT_DIR:-/workspace/.torch_ext}/sg_tp8_scratch
9	ROOT=/workspace/SuperGrok1.5
10	SRC=$ROOT/tuning/_tp8_scratch_pybind.cu
11	NVCC=/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc
12	CXX=c++
13	TORCH=/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/torch
14	PYINC=/usr/include/python3.11
15	
16	mkdir -p "$BD"
17	cd "$BD"
18	
19	CUDA_CFLAGS="-DTORCH_EXTENSION_NAME=sg_tp8_scratch -DTORCH_API_INCLUDE_EXTENSION_H \
20	-DPYBIND11_COMPILER_TYPE=\"_gcc\" -DPYBIND11_STDLIB=\"_libstdcpp\" -DPYBIND11_BUILD_ABI=\"_cxxabi1011\" \
21	-I$ROOT -isystem $TORCH/include -isystem $TORCH/include/torch/csrc/api/include \
22	-isystem $TORCH/include/TH -isystem $TORCH/include/THC -isystem /usr/local/cuda/include \
23	-isystem $PYINC -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0 \
24	--expt-relaxed-constexpr -gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a --compiler-options -fPIC \
25	-O3 -std=c++17 -DSG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL=1 -DSG_FUSED_SM90_DECODER_LAYOUT_CUH_=1 \
26	-include csrc/fused/sm_90/decoder_flagship_layout.cuh -DSG_HAS_NVSHMEM=1 -rdc=true \
27	-I$NVSHMEM_HOME/include \
28	-U__CUDA_NO_HALF_OPERATORS__ -U__CUDA_NO_HALF_CONVERSIONS__ -U__CUDA_NO_HALF2_OPERATORS__ \
29	-U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16_OPERATORS__ -U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16_CONVERSIONS__ -U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT162_OPERATORS__"
30	
31	echo "[build] 1/3 compile (-rdc=true -dc) ..."
32	# -dc == --relocatable-device-code=true -c ; we pass -rdc=true above + -c here.
33	cd "$ROOT"   # so -include relative path resolves
34	$NVCC $CUDA_CFLAGS -c "$SRC" -o "$BD/_tp8_scratch_pybind.cuda.o"
35	
36	echo "[build] 2/3 device-link (-dlink against libnvshmem_device) ..."
37	# Use the NAMED -lnvshmem_device (NOT -l:libnvshmem_device.a): nvlink only resolves
38	# the archive's device members transitively with the named -l form. The -l: exact
39	# form leaves nvshmemi_transfer_quiet / nvshmemi_device_state_d undefined.
40	# -Xcompiler -fPIC is REQUIRED: the dlink object carries a __fatbinwrap relocation
41	# that ld rejects in a shared object unless PIC.
42	$NVCC -dlink -gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a -Xcompiler -fPIC \
43	    "$BD/_tp8_scratch_pybind.cuda.o" \
44	    -L"$NVSHMEM_HOME/lib" -lnvshmem_device \

50	-Wl,-rpath,$NVSHMEM_HOME/lib -L$TORCH/lib -lc10 -lc10_cuda -ltorch_cpu -ltorch_cuda \
51	-ltorch -ltorch_python -L/usr/local/cuda/lib64 -lcudart -lcudadevrt"
52	$CXX "$BD/_tp8_scratch_pybind.cuda.o" "$BD/_tp8_scratch_dlink.o" $LDFLAGS -o "$BD/sg_tp8_scratch.so"

2	across all 8 H100s via TP8 + ZeRO-3, driving the IN-KERNEL device-NVSHMEM all-reduce.
3	
4	Per rank (torchrun --nproc_per_node=8):
5	  1. import the bringup ext (sets NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NVLS=1 / NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0),
6	     init torch.distributed (NCCL).
7	  2. NVSHMEM UID bootstrap + team_split(0,1,8) + a collective sym malloc via the
8	     validated sg_nvshmem_bringup pybind → brings up the process-global NVSHMEM world
9	     the megakernel's in-kernel nvshmem_* calls share.
10	  3. JIT-build the scratch TP8 pybind (_tp8_scratch_pybind.cu) with the flagship
11	     layout force-included + -DSG_HAS_NVSHMEM=1 -rdc=true + device-linked nvshmem.
12	  4. TP-shard the 1.476B weights (partition_tensor_parallel) → report per-rank
13	     resident params; ZeRO-3 shards the AdamW state.
14	  5. run N steps of tc_train_step_tp8 (the ParTP8 in-kernel all-reduce path) on a
15	     fixed TP-replicated real batch; verify cross-rank loss AGREES + loss DESCENDS.
16	
17	USAGE: torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 tuning/_tp8_run.py --steps 30 --ncta 64
18	"""

20	import argparse, math, os, sys

23	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

30	def build_tp8_module(verbose=False, only_rank0_build=True, rank=0):
31	    """Build the scratch TP8 pybind via the manual driver (_tp8_build.sh) which adds
32	    the device-link (-dlink) step torch's JIT load() omits for -rdc=true objects,
33	    then import the resulting .so. torch's load() cannot device-link an RDC TU
34	    against libnvshmem_device.a (it leaves __cudaRegisterLinkedBinary unresolved)."""
35	    import torch  # noqa  (ensure libtorch is in the process before dlopen of the .so)
36	    import importlib.util  # noqa
37	    import subprocess  # noqa
38	    home = os.environ.get("NVSHMEM_HOME",
39	                          "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/nvidia/nvshmem")
40	    bd = os.path.join(os.environ.get("SG_TORCH_EXT_DIR", "/workspace/.torch_ext"),
41	                      "sg_tp8_scratch")
42	    so = os.path.join(bd, "sg_tp8_scratch.so")
43	    env = dict(os.environ); env["NVSHMEM_HOME"] = home
44	    src_mtime = os.path.getmtime(_SCRATCH_TU)
45	    fresh = os.path.exists(so) and os.path.getmtime(so) >= src_mtime
46	    # Only one rank compiles (avoid 8 concurrent nvcc on the same .o). Others wait.
47	    # Skip the (slow) rebuild when the cached .so is newer than the source.
48	    if (rank == 0) and not fresh:
49	        subprocess.run(["bash", str(ROOT / "tuning/_tp8_build.sh")], check=True,
50	                       env=env, stdout=(None if verbose else subprocess.DEVNULL),
51	                       stderr=(None if verbose else subprocess.STDOUT))
52	    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("sg_tp8_scratch", so)
53	    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)

128	        print(f"[tp8] NVSHMEM up: world_pe={mod_nv.world_pe()} npes={mod_nv.world_npes()} "
129	              f"team={team} tp_n_pes={mod_nv.tp_n_pes()} sym_heap=0x{heap:x} "
130	              f"sym_floats={sym_floats:,}", flush=True)
131	
132	    # ---- 2. TP weight-shard report (resident params per rank) ----
133	    tp_plan = partition_tensor_parallel(flagship_named_shapes(), tp, rank, model="decoder")
134	    if rank == 0:
135	        print(f"[tp8] TP weight-shard: {len(tp_plan.shards)} tensors, "
136	              f"{tp_plan.n_split} split / {len(tp_plan.shards)-tp_plan.n_split} replicated; "
137	              f"per-rank Nmax={tp_plan.max_shard_numel:,} (== {fb.FLAGSHIP_NMAX//tp:,}? "
138	              f"{tp_plan.max_shard_numel == fb.FLAGSHIP_NMAX//tp}); "
139	              f"per-rank resident params={tp_plan.total_shard_numel:,} of {tp_plan.total_full_numel:,}",
140	              flush=True)
141	
142	    # ---- 3. build the scratch TP8 megakernel ----
143	    seed_everything(args.seed)
144	    mod = build_tp8_module(verbose=args.verbose_build and rank == 0)
145	    assert int(mod.D) == fb.FLAGSHIP_D and int(mod.TOTAL) == fb.FLAGSHIP_TOTAL_PARAMS, \
146	        f"built D={int(mod.D)} TOTAL={int(mod.TOTAL)} (layout swap failed)"
147	    if rank == 0:
148	        print(f"[tp8] flagship module built: D={int(mod.D)} L={int(mod.LAYERS)} "
149	              f"TOTAL={int(mod.TOTAL):,} NUMT={int(mod.NUMT)}", flush=True)
150	
151	    # ---- 4. params (replicated, identical seed) + ZeRO-3 sharded state ----
152	    g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(args.seed)
153	    params = (torch.randn(fb.FLAGSHIP_TOTAL_PARAMS, generator=g, device=device) * 0.02).contiguous()
154	    total = fb.FLAGSHIP_TOTAL_PARAMS
155	    # state buffer: >= 3*total + 1 (m|v|extra|loss). state-planes>=3.
156	    state = torch.zeros(max(args.state_planes, 3) * total + 8, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
157	    tokens, targets = make_real_batch(args.batch, args.seed, fb.FLAGSHIP_VOCAB, device)
158	
159	    # per-rank GiB (resident)
160	    def gib():
161	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
162	        return torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / (1024**3)
163	
164	    lr, b1, b2, eps, wd = 1e-3, 0.9, 0.98, 1e-8, 0.0
165	    bc1, bc2 = 1.0 - b1, 1.0 - b2
166	    losses = []
167	    cross_ok = True
168	    for step in range(1, args.steps + 1):
169	        loss, _g = mod.tc_train_step_tp8(params, tokens, targets, state,
170	                                         lr, b1, b2, eps, wd, bc1, bc2, step, args.ncta)
171	        lv = float(loss.item()); losses.append(lv)
172	        if step <= args.verify_steps:
173	            lt = torch.tensor([lv], device=device, dtype=torch.float64)
174	            gath = [torch.zeros_like(lt) for _ in range(world)]
175	            torch.cuda.synchronize(); dist.all_gather(gath, lt); torch.cuda.synchronize()
176	            dloss = max(abs(x.item() - lv) for x in gath)
177	            if rank == 0:
178	                vals = [x.item() for x in gath]
179	                print(f"[step {step}] loss={lv:.6f} cross-rank dloss={dloss:.3e} "
180	                      f"min={min(vals):.6f} max={max(vals):.6f}", flush=True)
181	            if dloss >= 1e-6:
182	                cross_ok = False
183	                if rank == 0:
184	                    print(f"[tp8] WARNING cross-rank loss disagree d={dloss:.3e} step {step}", flush=True)
185	
186	    per_rank_gib = gib()
187	    all_gib = [None] * world
188	    dist.all_gather_object(all_gib, per_rank_gib)
189	    descends = len(losses) >= 2 and losses[-1] < losses[0]
190	    if rank == 0:
191	        print(f"[tp8] DONE steps={len(losses)} loss[0]={losses[0]:.6f} -> "
192	              f"loss[-1]={losses[-1]:.6f}  init ln(99)={math.log(99):.4f}", flush=True)
193	        print(f"[tp8] descends={descends} cross_rank_agree={cross_ok} "
194	              f"per_rank_GiB={per_rank_gib:.2f} all_ranks_GiB={[round(x,2) for x in all_gib]}",
195	              flush=True)
196	        print(f"[tp8] RESULT_JSON {{'ran_8gpu': true, 'steps': {len(losses)}, "
197	              f"'loss0': {losses[0]:.6f}, 'lossN': {losses[-1]:.6f}, "
198	              f"'descends': {str(descends).lower()}, 'cross_rank_agree': {str(cross_ok).lower()}, "
199	              f"'per_rank_gib': {per_rank_gib:.3f}}}", flush=True)
200	    dist.barrier()
201	    mod_nv.barrier_world()
202	    dist.destroy_process_group()
203	    return 0
204	
205	
206	if __name__ == "__main__":
207	    raise SystemExit(main())

3	//
4	// WHY THIS TU EXISTS (the GEMM_IMPL=wgmma wiring, owner directive task 1): the
5	// shipped scalar launcher mega_decoder_real_adamw.cu compiles the SCALAR cell only
6	// (its own #error refuses SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL=wgmma — no-suppression guard, never
7	// links a scalar body under a wgmma name). The Fork-B tensor-core cell driver
8	// (mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc.cu) DOES build the wgmma branch but owns its own
9	// PYBIND11_MODULE, so setup.py's _collect() drops it from _ops (PyInit__ops
10	// collision). The race path (dispatch.cpp → _try_fused_train_step) therefore had
11	// NO way to reach the TC kernel — bf16 race configs silently ran eager.
12	//
13	// This TU is the missing seam: it is globbed INTO _ops (no own pybind module), is
14	// compiled with -DSG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL=1 (per-TU; see setup.py's per-source nvcc
15	// flag rewrite) so it links the wgmma branch of fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh, and
16	// exposes ONE non-template host launcher whose boundary is plain pointers/ints +
17	// the FusedScalars POD — NO header-only types (DecoderTokenCtx/FusedOptState)
18	// cross the boundary — so dispatch.cpp can `extern`-declare it with only the
19	// mirror structs it already has. It calls ONLY launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc
20	// (the TC launcher); it never instantiates the scalar launcher template, so it
21	// CANNOT collide (ODR/duplicate-symbol) with the scalar TU even though both are in
22	// _ops. The TC activations/grad workspace is sized DIFFERENTLY from the scalar
23	// nCTA*total partials (dec_tc_workspace_floats), so this TU owns its own cached
24	// scratch internally — dispatch.cpp passes no workspace for the TC path.
25	//
26	// HONESTY: this is the REAL bf16 wgmma path (HGMMA in SASS, validated by
27	// tests/hw/test_decoder_tc.py). No scalar fallback, no surrogate. The scalar TU
28	// (mega_decoder_real_adamw.cu) is UNTOUCHED and remains the fp32 path.
29	
30	#define SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL 1   // select the wgmma cell driver (Fork-B TC branch)
31	
32	#include <cuda_runtime.h>
33	#include <cstdint>
34	#include "csrc/fused/sm_90/fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh"
35	#if defined(SG_HAS_NVSHMEM)
36	#include <nvshmem.h>   // nvshmem_malloc/_free + nvshmem_team_my_pe + NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD (EDIT E)
37	#endif

39	namespace sg { namespace fused { namespace sm90 {
40	
41	namespace {
42	// Persistent barrier/queue counters + the TC activations/grad workspace, cached
43	// per device. Mirrors mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc.cu::TcScratch but uses raw
44	// cudaMalloc (this TU is inside _ops; it has c10 available, but raw allocation
45	// keeps the launcher free of any ATen-tensor lifetime questions on the hot path —
46	// the buffers are process-lived scratch, recreated only when a larger B needs a
47	// bigger workspace). Zeroed in-kernel (P0) each launch; never freed (one per
48	// device, leaked at process exit like every other cuBLAS/cuDNN handle).
49	struct DecTcLauncherScratch {
50	    int*     g_next = nullptr;        // int [1]
51	    unsigned* g_arrived = nullptr;    // unsigned [1]
52	    unsigned* g_generation = nullptr; // unsigned [1]
53	    float*   workspace = nullptr;     // float [dec_tc_workspace_floats(T,B,nCTA)]  (cudaMalloc — acts/grad/state)
54	    int64_t  ws_floats = 0;
55	#if defined(SG_HAS_NVSHMEM)
56	    // SYMMETRIC TP-slot heap (nvshmem_malloc — the ONLY operands that need cross-PE
57	    // addressing; tp_nvshmem.md §2 Option A). Sized to the WORLD-UNIFORM per-PE
58	    // stride so every PE's collective nvshmem_malloc agrees. nullptr on the TP==1 /
59	    // no-NVSHMEM path.
60	    float*   tp_sym_heap = nullptr;   // nvshmem_malloc'd [tp_sym_floats]
61	    int64_t  tp_sym_floats = 0;
62	#endif
63	    int      dev = -1;
64	};
65	
66	DecTcLauncherScratch& dec_tc_launcher_scratch(int dev, int64_t need_floats) {
67	    static DecTcLauncherScratch s;
68	    if (s.dev != dev) {
69	        // First use on this device (or a device switch — the race is single-GPU,
70	        // but be honest if it ever moves): (re)allocate the counters.
71	        s.dev = dev;
72	        if (!s.g_next)      cudaMalloc(&s.g_next, sizeof(int));
73	        if (!s.g_arrived)   cudaMalloc(&s.g_arrived, sizeof(unsigned));
74	        if (!s.g_generation)cudaMalloc(&s.g_generation, sizeof(unsigned));
75	    }
76	    if (s.ws_floats < need_floats) {
77	        if (s.workspace) cudaFree(s.workspace);
78	        cudaMalloc(&s.workspace, (size_t)need_floats * sizeof(float));
79	        s.ws_floats = need_floats;
80	    }
81	    return s;
82	}
83	
84	#if defined(SG_HAS_NVSHMEM)
85	// Ensure the symmetric TP-slot heap is sized >= need_sym_floats. COLLECTIVE:
86	// every PE must call nvshmem_malloc with the SAME size in the SAME order, so the
87	// caller passes the WORLD-UNIFORM stride (computed from the global shapes, not a
88	// per-rank size). nvshmem_malloc is a collective barrier internally; call it from
89	// the host TP-group bootstrap BEFORE the kernel launch.
90	void dec_tc_ensure_tp_sym_heap(DecTcLauncherScratch& s, int64_t need_sym_floats) {
91	    if (s.tp_sym_floats >= need_sym_floats) return;
92	    if (s.tp_sym_heap) nvshmem_free(s.tp_sym_heap);
93	    s.tp_sym_heap   = static_cast<float*>(
94	        nvshmem_malloc((size_t)need_sym_floats * sizeof(float)));
95	    s.tp_sym_floats = need_sym_floats;
96	}
97	#endif
98	}  // anonymous namespace

100	// mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc — the WIRED TC launcher. Boundary mirrors the scalar
101	// mega_decoder_real_adamw (dispatch.cpp extern-decls it with the same mirror
102	// types) EXCEPT it takes NO workspace pointer: the TC workspace is a different
103	// size from the scalar nCTA*total partials, so this TU allocates+owns it. `loss_out`
104	// still points into the caller's state[3*total] slot (dispatch reads it back).
105	//
106	// OPTID-GENERIC (owner baseline directive — all 33 cells on L3-TC): the fwd+bwd+
107	// grad-reduction is OPTIMIZER-INDEPENDENT (the same validated wgmma decoder kernel);
108	// ONLY the per-element optimizer TAIL (apply_optimizer<Opt>) differs, and that tail
109	// is the 14/0-apply-parity math already in opt_components.cuh. So this launcher
110	// takes `opt_id` (the OptId int) and dispatches to the matching kernel instantiation
111	// over the SAME state buffer. The state layout is [m | v | extra] (3*total) + loss:
112	//   * lion              uses m only (v/extra unread; bound harmlessly)
113	//   * adamw             uses m, v
114	//   * grokfast/grokadamw use m, v, ema  (ema == the `extra` slice, state + 2*total)
115	//   * neuralgrok        uses m, v, AND a psi-net weight pack the cell supplies in the
116	//                       `extra` slice (kPsiPackFloats floats); st.psi_W1/b1/W2 bind
117	//                       to those offsets, exactly as opt_components.cuh documents.
118	// The STAGED optimizers prodigy (P2.6 global-d) and muon (P2.7 grid-cooperative NS)
119	// ARE routed here: their precompute is an IN-KERNEL phase, so they remain a SINGLE
120	// persistent launch (the cases below). The SAM-coupled SG11/SG15/looksam and SG2 are
121	// NOT — they need a 2nd in-kernel fwd+bwd / a sharpness ABI field / a segmented sort
122	// that this single-launch path does not carry; dispatch.cpp gates them out (and
123	// wiring_check fails them loud with the cited reason). NeuralGrok is wired but its
124	// host-trained amplifier is a separate concern (the race fn gates it).
125	//
126	// ncta_cap: forwarded to the TC launcher (0 = one CTA/SM = full saturation, the
127	// shipped config). The race always passes 0.
128	cudaError_t mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc(
129	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params,
130	        const int* tokens, const int* targets, int B,
131	        float* state, float* grad, float* /*workspace_unused*/, float* loss_out,
132	        const int* sizes, const int* offsets,
133	        float lr, int step, const FusedScalars& scalars, cudaStream_t stream,
134	        int ncta_cap, int opt_id, int tp_size) {
135	    (void)sizes; (void)offsets;  // TC kernel reads kDecSizes/kDecOffsets directly.
136	    (void)tp_size;               // unread unless SG_HAS_NVSHMEM (TP dispatch arm below).
137	    // NOTE: this is the TP-AWARE definition (trailing int tp_size). The original
138	    // 17-arg boundary dispatch.cpp links is provided as a thin BYTE-IDENTICAL
139	    // forwarder OVERLOAD just below this function (tp_size=1), so the shipped _ops
140	    // symbol is unchanged and dispatch.cpp needs no edit — the new tp_size>1 path
141	    // is reached only by a (future) dispatch.cpp caller of this 18-arg overload.
142	
143	    const int64_t total = kDecTotalElems;
144	    const int T = B * dec::kSeq;
145	
146	    int dev = 0;
147	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
148	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
149	    int n_sms = 1;
150	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
151	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
152	    int nCTA = n_sms;
153	    if (ncta_cap > 0 && ncta_cap < nCTA) nCTA = ncta_cap;
154	
155	    const int64_t need = dec_tc_workspace_floats(T, B, nCTA);
156	    DecTcLauncherScratch& sc = dec_tc_launcher_scratch(dev, need);
157	
158	    // Re-point the ctx counters at THIS TU's cached counters (dispatch.cpp built
159	    // ctx pointing at its scalar DecoderScratch counters; the TC launcher zeroes
160	    // them per-launch, but they must be the ones this scratch owns so the grid
161	    // barrier is consistent with the workspace).
162	    ctx.g_next_task   = sc.g_next;
163	    ctx.g_arrived     = sc.g_arrived;
164	    ctx.g_generation  = sc.g_generation;
165	    ctx.n_tasks       = kDecNumTensors;  // parameter tensors for reduce+opt phases
166	
167	    // Bind the optimizer state slices. [m | v | extra] over the SAME state buffer;
168	    // each tail reads only its own buffers (opt_components.cuh guarantees unused
169	    // pointers are never dereferenced). ema/psi-net live in the `extra` slice.
170	    float* const m_slice     = state;
171	    float* const v_slice     = state + total;
172	    float* const extra_slice = state + 2 * total;
173	    FusedOptState st;
174	    st.exp_avg    = m_slice;
175	    st.exp_avg_sq = v_slice;
176	    st.ema        = extra_slice;          // grokfast/grokadamw slow-grad EMA
177	    // NeuralGrok psi-net pack (kPsiPackFloats floats at the head of `extra`): the
178	    // cell places [psi_W1 | psi_b1 | psi_W2 | psi_b2] there; bind the device pointers
179	    // so the apply reads real weights (psi_b2 is read on-device from psi_W2[kPsiHidden]).
180	    st.psi_W1     = extra_slice + kPsiW1Off;
181	    st.psi_b1     = extra_slice + kPsiB1Off;
182	    st.psi_W2     = extra_slice + kPsiW2Off;
183	    // PRODIGY (STAGED global-d) state bindings. The cell extends the state buffer
184	    // to [m | v | extra/s_track | loss | param_init | r_ema | s_ema | d_lr] (host
185	    // sizes it to >= 4*total + 4; see dispatch.fused_train_step). The `extra` slice
186	    // doubles as Prodigy's `s` trajectory accumulator (the apply reads st.s_track,
187	    // not st.ema — they alias here, harmless: Prodigy has no slow-grad EMA). The
188	    // trajectory anchor p0 (param_init) follows the loss slot; the 3 persisted
189	    // estimator scalars [r_ema | s_ema | d_lr] follow param_init. loss_out points at
190	    // state+3*total (dispatch's loss_slot), so param_init = loss_out + 1.
191	    st.s_track        = extra_slice;            // Prodigy `s` (per-element accumulator)
192	    st.param_init     = loss_out + 1;           // state + 3*total + 1
193	    st.prodigy_persist = loss_out + 1 + total;  // [r_ema | s_ema | d_lr]
194	    // LookSAM (MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward): sam_dir is the PERSISTENT cached SAM
195	    // direction (g_sam − g), carried across steps in the `extra` slice (aliases the
196	    // grokfast EMA / Prodigy s_track slot — harmless: LookSAM has none of those). The
197	    // in-kernel P2.4 phase WRITES it on SAM steps; the apply tail READS it every step.
198	    st.sam_dir        = extra_slice;            // [total] cached SAM direction
199	    // SuperGrok11/15 (MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward + per-tensor meta-net mu). State
200	    // layout: [m | v | mu | loss | sharpness(total) | phi_pack(4H+1)].
201	    //   * st.mu = the `extra` slice (recomputed each step by the P2.45 precompute; the
202	    //     apply reads it — it aliases sam_dir/ema/s_track, harmless: SG has none).
203	    //   * st.sharpness = loss_slot+1 (PERSISTED (g_sam−g)²; the P2.4 SAM 2nd backward
204	    //     writes it on SAM steps, the cached value is reused on intervening steps).
205	    //   * st.sg_phi_W1/b1/W2 = the phi pack at sharpness+total (host-scattered each step,
206	    //     like NeuralGrok's psi pack); sg_phi_b2 is read on-device from sg_phi_W2[H].
207	    st.mu             = extra_slice;            // [total] meta-net mu (P2.45-filled)
208	    {
209	        float* sharp_base = loss_out + 1;       // state + 3*total + 1
210	        float* phi_base   = sharp_base + total; // phi pack after sharpness
211	        st.sharpness = sharp_base;
212	        st.sg_phi_W1 = phi_base + kSgPhiW1Off;
213	        st.sg_phi_b1 = phi_base + kSgPhiB1Off;
214	        st.sg_phi_W2 = phi_base + kSgPhiW2Off;  // sg_phi_b2 read on-device from [H]
215	    }
216	    apply_scalars(st, scalars);   // FULL scalar set (un-frozen bc1/bc2/... + d0/d_coef/beta3 + rho/looksam_sam/sg_rescale)
217	    st.lr = lr;
218	
219	    DecoderTokenCtx tok;
220	    tok.tokens    = tokens;
221	    tok.targets   = targets;
222	    tok.B         = B;
223	    tok.workspace = sc.workspace;
224	    tok.loss_out  = loss_out;
225	
226	    // Dispatch to the matching kernel instantiation. The fwd+bwd is identical across
227	    // these OptIds; the template differs ONLY in the P3 apply_optimizer<Opt> tail.
228	    // Unsupported opt_ids return cudaErrorInvalidValue → dispatch.cpp throws LOUD (no
229	    // silent scalar/adamw fallback — the no-suppression rule). The STAGED/model-coupled
230	    // optimizers are intentionally NOT cases here (they cannot run as a single launch).
231	    switch (static_cast<OptId>(opt_id)) {
232	        case OptId::AdamW:
233	#if defined(SG_HAS_NVSHMEM)
234	            // TP allow-list (the §1.3/§7.2 explicit-instantiation gate): {1, 8}.
235	            // DP rides in CommCtx at runtime (no Par::kDP read in the kernel), so a
236	            // fixed DP sentinel avoids a DP×TP instantiation matrix (dist_step.md §6.C.4).
237	            if (tp_size == 8) {
238	                using ParTP8 = ::sg::fused::par::ParConfig<
239	                    /*DP=*/8, /*TP=*/8, /*PP=*/1, /*SP=*/1,
240	                    ::sg::fused::par::ZeROStage::Z3>;
241	                // Symmetric TP-slot heap: one publish+reduced slot per CTA-in-PE.
242	                // WORLD-UNIFORM stride (every PE agrees) = ctas_per_pe·2·kTileM·d.
243	                const int P = tp_size;
244	                const int ctas_per_pe = nCTA / P;   // launcher asserts nCTA % P == 0
245	                const int64_t sym_floats =
246	                    ::sg::fused::sm90::tp::tp_heap_stride_floats(ctas_per_pe);
247	                dec_tc_ensure_tp_sym_heap(sc, sym_floats);
248	                ::sg::fused::par::CommCtx comm{};
249	                comm.world_size = 8; comm.tp_size = 8; comm.dp_size = 8;
250	                comm.tp_rank = nvshmem_team_my_pe(/*TP team*/NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD);
251	                comm.tp_sym_heap = sc.tp_sym_heap;
252	                comm.tp_heap_stride_floats = sym_floats;
253	                comm.tp_team_n_pes  = 8;
254	                comm.tp_team_local_pe = comm.tp_rank;
255	                // Store the TP team id as void* (int32 team → intptr → void*); the
256	                // host bootstrap that nvshmem_team_split_strided's the TP group sets
257	                // the real team — NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD for the single-node pure-TP run.
258	                comm.tp_comm_handle = reinterpret_cast<void*>(
259	                    static_cast<intptr_t>(NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD));
260	                return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::AdamW, ParTP8>(
261	                    ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA, comm);
262	            }
263	#endif
264	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::AdamW>(
265	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
266	        case OptId::Lion:
267	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::Lion>(
268	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
269	        case OptId::Grokfast:
270	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::Grokfast>(
271	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
272	        case OptId::GrokAdamW:
273	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::GrokAdamW>(
274	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
275	        case OptId::NeuralGrok:
276	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::NeuralGrok>(
277	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
278	        case OptId::Prodigy:
279	            // STAGED global-d: the SAME single persistent launch — the d-estimate
280	            // cross-tensor reduction is an IN-KERNEL phase (P2.6, between B2 and P3),
281	            // not a separate launch. st carries param_init/prodigy_persist/d0/d_coef/

336	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params,
337	        const int* tokens, const int* targets, int B,
338	        float* state, float* grad, float* workspace_unused, float* loss_out,

348	// CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU meta-net weight bundle (26 HBM pointers, model-independent) +
349	// per-tensor scalar ARRAYS (alpha/gru_decay/lamb_eff/beta1/bc1/bc2, length P) +
350	// the meta-net state (m/v/mu/slow/gru_state/sharpness), none of which fit the
351	// FusedScalars POD or the generic mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc boundary. So this is
352	// a PARALLEL entry (the generic launcher + the 28 byte-identical cells are
353	// UNTOUCHED). It binds the SG2 state slices, threads the weight bundle + scalar
354	// arrays through FusedOptState's sg2_* fields, and dispatches the OptId::SuperGrok2
355	// kernel instantiation (its P3-SG2 phase runs sg2_meta_stages per tensor: STAGE -1
356	// in-kernel segmented sort → CSA/HCA/GRU/PEER/apply, reading st.sharpness from the
357	// SAM 2nd backward (P2.4, shared with SG11/15)).
358	//
359	// STATE LAYOUT (host sizes it; this carves it):
360	//   [m(total) | v(total) | mu(total) | loss(1) | sharpness(total) | slow(total)
361	//    | gru_state(total*GH)]   ⇒ min_state = (4+1+GH)*total + 1   (GH=gru_hidden=4)
362	// perm/unsort are built IN-KERNEL into the per-CTA workspace (NOT state).
363	cudaError_t mega_decoder_sg2_tc(
364	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params,
365	        const int* tokens, const int* targets, int B,
366	        float* state, float* grad, float* loss_out,
367	        // SG2 meta-net weight bundle (HBM, fp32, model-independent), in SG2Weights order.
368	        const float* input_proj_W, const float* input_proj_b,
369	        const float* csa_q_W, const float* csa_k_W, const float* csa_v_W, const float* csa_out_W,

371	        const float* hca_q_W, const float* hca_k_W, const float* hca_v_W, const float* hca_out_W,
372	        const float* gru_Wz, const float* gru_bz, const float* gru_Wr, const float* gru_br,
373	        const float* gru_Wh, const float* gru_bh,
374	        const float* peer_query_Ws, const float* prod_keys_A, const float* prod_keys_B,
375	        const float* expert_W1, const float* expert_b1, const float* expert_W2, const float* expert_b2,
376	        // per-tensor scalar arrays (device, length kDecNumTensors).
377	        const float* sc_alpha, const float* sc_gru_decay, const float* sc_lamb_eff,
378	        const float* sc_beta1, const float* sc_bc1, const float* sc_bc2,
379	        // shared scalars + the SAM 2nd-backward gate (SG2 reuses the LookSAM P2.4
380	        // machinery: rho = perturbation radius, sam_on = every-k SAM-step gate).
381	        float rescale, float beta2, float lr, float wd, float eps,
382	        float rho, float sam_on,
383	        int step, cudaStream_t stream, int ncta_cap) {
384	    const int64_t total = kDecTotalElems;
385	    // gru_state spans total*GH (GH=DecSG2Dims::gru_hidden); the layout is fixed by
386	    // the kernel's SG2State carve, so the slices below need no GH arithmetic here.
387	    const int T = B * dec::kSeq;
388	
389	    int dev = 0;
390	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
391	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
392	    int n_sms = 1;
393	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
394	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
395	    int nCTA = n_sms;
396	    if (ncta_cap > 0 && ncta_cap < nCTA) nCTA = ncta_cap;
397	
398	    const int64_t need = dec_tc_workspace_floats(T, B, nCTA);
399	    DecTcLauncherScratch& sc = dec_tc_launcher_scratch(dev, need);
400	    ctx.g_next_task   = sc.g_next;
401	    ctx.g_arrived     = sc.g_arrived;
402	    ctx.g_generation  = sc.g_generation;
403	    ctx.n_tasks       = kDecNumTensors;
404	
405	    // Bind the SG2 state slices: [m | v | mu | loss | sharpness | slow | gru_state].
406	    FusedOptState st;
407	    st.exp_avg     = state;                       // m
408	    st.exp_avg_sq  = state + total;               // v
409	    st.mu          = state + 2 * total;           // expert-output EMA
410	    // loss_out points at state + 3*total (dispatch's loss slot).
411	    float* sharp_base = loss_out + 1;             // state + 3*total + 1
412	    st.sharpness   = sharp_base;                  // (g_sam − g)² (SAM 2nd backward, P2.4)
413	    st.sg2_slow    = sharp_base + total;          // grokfast slow-grad EMA
414	    st.sg2_gru_state = st.sg2_slow + total;       // [total*GH] per-element GRU state
415	    // meta-net weight bundle (HBM).
416	    st.sg2_input_proj_W = input_proj_W; st.sg2_input_proj_b = input_proj_b;
417	    st.sg2_csa_q_W = csa_q_W; st.sg2_csa_k_W = csa_k_W; st.sg2_csa_v_W = csa_v_W;
418	    st.sg2_csa_out_W = csa_out_W; st.sg2_csa_compress_w = csa_compress_w;
419	    st.sg2_csa_idx_DQ = csa_idx_DQ; st.sg2_csa_idx_K = csa_idx_K;
420	    st.sg2_hca_q_W = hca_q_W; st.sg2_hca_k_W = hca_k_W; st.sg2_hca_v_W = hca_v_W;
421	    st.sg2_hca_out_W = hca_out_W;
422	    st.sg2_gru_Wz = gru_Wz; st.sg2_gru_bz = gru_bz; st.sg2_gru_Wr = gru_Wr;
423	    st.sg2_gru_br = gru_br; st.sg2_gru_Wh = gru_Wh; st.sg2_gru_bh = gru_bh;
424	    st.sg2_peer_query_Ws = peer_query_Ws; st.sg2_prod_keys_A = prod_keys_A;
425	    st.sg2_prod_keys_B = prod_keys_B;
426	    st.sg2_expert_W1 = expert_W1; st.sg2_expert_b1 = expert_b1;
427	    st.sg2_expert_W2 = expert_W2; st.sg2_expert_b2 = expert_b2;
428	    // per-tensor scalar arrays.
429	    st.sg2_alpha = sc_alpha; st.sg2_gru_decay = sc_gru_decay; st.sg2_lamb_eff = sc_lamb_eff;
430	    st.sg2_beta1 = sc_beta1; st.sg2_bc1 = sc_bc1; st.sg2_bc2 = sc_bc2;
431	    st.sg2_rescale = rescale;
432	    // shared scalars the SG2 phase reads (beta2/lr/wd/eps via FusedScalars fields).
433	    st.beta2 = beta2; st.lr = lr; st.wd = wd; st.eps = eps;
434	    // SAM 2nd-backward gate: SG2 reuses the LookSAM P2.4 machinery. st.rho is the
435	    // perturbation radius (SG2's sam_rho); st.looksam_sam is the every-k SAM-step gate
436	    // (1.0 ⇒ run the in-kernel perturb→2nd fwd+bwd→sharpness=(g_sam−g)² this step;
437	    // 0.0 ⇒ reuse the cached sharpness). On a non-SAM step the cached sharpness feeds
438	    // the meta-net verbatim (eager-faithful).
439	    st.rho = rho;
440	    st.looksam_sam = sam_on;
441	
442	    DecoderTokenCtx tok;
443	    tok.tokens    = tokens;
444	    tok.targets   = targets;
445	    tok.B         = B;
446	    tok.workspace = sc.workspace;
447	    tok.loss_out  = loss_out;
448	
449	    return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::SuperGrok2>(
450	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
451	}

Now I understand the layout. Flagship: d=1600, heads=25, dhead=64, dff=6400, layers=48, vocab=99, seq=4.

With TP=8: `3d/P = 4800/8 = 600`, `dff/P = 6400/8 = 800`, `d/P = 1600/8 = 200`. These divide evenly. But `kHeads/P = 25/8 = 3` with remainder — so `Hloc=3`, `Dloc=200`, `Hloc*kDhead = 3*64 = 192 != 200`. **This is the invariant violation** (bug B): the attention head-split assumes `Dloc == Hloc*kDhead`, but 200 != 192. So the attention writes `ctx[(rbase+qi)*Dloc + qoff + t]` where `qoff = hh*kDhead` up to `2*64+63=191 < 200` OK, but only 3 heads written into a 200-wide block — 8 columns (192-199) are garbage, AND v-block reads at `2*Dloc+qoff` = `400+qoff`. The qkv buffer was produced column-parallel with `qkv_nout = 3d/P = 600`, treating it as `[q(200)|k(200)|v(200)]`. But the in_proj column-shard does NOT produce `[q_own|k_own|v_own]` contiguously — that's bug A's subtle correctness issue too.

Let me now understand exactly how column-parallel sharding maps to the weight matrix. Let me read tp_layer.cuh fully (it's the design doc + the primitives).

237	template <int N, class Transport, class WT>
238	__device__ __forceinline__ void tp_colparallel_dx_partial_tile(

245	}

253	//      dW_own[Nout, Kin/P] = dY^T @ X_own        (dY full/replicated)

256	//  rank-local stream/extent — this helper performs that transform. Biases:

258	//  replicated db = Σ_K dY computed identically on every rank.
259	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
260	__device__ __host__ __forceinline__ void tp_shard_extents(
261	        TpSplit split, int P, int Nout_full, int Kin_full,

263	    switch (split) {
264	        case TpSplit::Col:
265	        case TpSplit::ColQKV: *Nout_local = Nout_full / P; *Kin_local = Kin_full;     break;
266	        case TpSplit::Row:    *Nout_local = Nout_full;     *Kin_local = Kin_full / P; break;
267	        default:              *Nout_local = Nout_full;     *Kin_local = Kin_full;     break;
268	    }
269	}

271	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
272	//  Symmetric-slot budget for one decoder layer's TP comm, in floats, per tile
273	//  row block of kTileM rows: the largest reduced payload is [kTileM, d] (both
274	//  fwd reduces and both bwd reduces are [rows, d]). The canonical heap plan
275	//  (the loopback binding + the future NVSHMEM bootstrap both size with this):
276	//      slot 0: partial  [kTileM · d]      (publish target)
277	//      slot 1: reduced  [kTileM · d]      (reduce output, when not fused into

279	//  per CONCURRENT tile in flight per PE. The persistent kernel runs ONE tile
280	//  per CTA at a time ⇒ heap stride = n_ctas_per_pe · 2 · kTileM · d floats.
281	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
282	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t tp_tile_slot_floats() {
283	    return (int64_t)dectc::kTileM * dec::kD;
284	}
285	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t tp_heap_stride_floats(int ctas_per_pe) {

This is the design contract. The critical realization:

**The `dec_bind`/`dectc_wbf_convert` read the FULL weight matrices from `params` with `kDecOffsets`, NOT a per-rank shard.** The design (tp_layer.cuh) assumes each rank STORES its dense shard. But the runner `_tp8_run.py` passes the **FULL replicated `params` blob** to every rank (line 153: `params = torch.randn(FLAGSHIP_TOTAL_PARAMS)`). So the weights are NOT pre-sharded on the host — every rank has the full blob.

This means the kernel must **index its shard out of the full blob** using `comm.tp_rank`. Currently `dectc_wbf_convert` and `dec_bind` read the full matrix identically on every rank (bug A). The GEMMs then use `qkv_nout = 3d/P` width but read `wb.in_w[li]` which points at the FULL matrix start → every rank computes the SAME first `3d/P` columns (q-block partial only), and the row-parallel out_proj reads `wb.out_w[li]` full matrix but with `Kloc = d/P` input width → reads the first `d/P` rows on every rank. Wrong partials, and dW writes full-width grad from narrow acts → **the IMA**.

Let me confirm the IMA location precisely. The IMA is a 4-byte global write, 32 contiguous threads, in the dW phase (`dectc_dw_run_tile`'s `out` lambda writes `grad[grad_off + m*Kin + n0 + n]`). Let me verify: addresses `0x12603c400` to `0x12616b400` (stride ~1.24MB). With `grad` allocated at... the grad tensor is `torch.zeros({total})` = 1.476B floats = 5.9GB. The IMA address is 35-38GiB BELOW the nvshmem heap, not below grad. Let me check what's at the wild address. Actually the dW writes to `grad` which is a normal cudaMalloc'd tensor, in-bounds.

Now I have enough understanding to design the fix. Let me re-derive the design holistically.

**Key facts:**
- Host passes the FULL replicated `params` blob to every rank (not pre-sharded).
- `comm.tp_rank` is the rank (0..7), `Par::kTP = 8`.
- Sharding must be done IN-KERNEL by indexing into the full blob.

**The cleanest correct design** (per the directive's bug A + B):
- Attention (in_proj qkv + out_proj) runs **FULL-WIDTH REPLICATED** on every rank (since kHeads=25 % 8 != 0). The out_proj all-reduce would double-count if every rank computed the full out_proj. So: attention computes full qkv → full ctx → full out_proj contribution, identically on all ranks. We must NOT all-reduce the attention out_proj (it's replicated, not sharded). 
- FFN (ff0 column-parallel + ff2 row-parallel) IS TP-sharded: rank r owns ff0 rows `[r*dff/P, (r+1)*dff/P)` and ff2 cols `[r*dff/P,...)`. The ff2 forward all-reduce sums the partial across ranks.

Wait — but if attention is fully replicated and produces the SAME r1 residual on every rank, and ff0/ff2 are sharded with an all-reduce that sums to the full result, then r2 is identical on every rank. Good — activations stay replicated and identical. The loss is identical on every rank (cross_rank_agree). 

**Gradients**: 
- ff0 (column-parallel): rank's dW_own = rows `[r*dff/P,...)` — exact slice of full dW. Each rank writes only its slice into grad. The other ranks' slices in grad stay zero on this rank. But the optimizer applies per-rank... and params are replicated. **Problem**: each rank only computes its ff0/ff2 grad slice, so after P3 each rank updates only its slice of ff0/ff2 and the FULL attention/embedding/LN/head (replicated grads). The replicated params would then DIVERGE across ranks for the ff0/ff2 slices that rank didn't compute.

This is the fundamental issue: with replicated params and sharded grads but NO cross-rank grad all-reduce, ranks diverge. The directive says "the existing in-kernel all-reduce sums the full-width result correctly" — that refers to the **activation** all-reduce (forward/backward dX), which makes the loss correct. But for the **weight update** to keep params replicated-consistent, we need either (a) each rank computes the FULL gradient (requires gathering all shards) or (b) a grad all-reduce, or (c) accept that each rank owns its shard and params are sharded.

Now let me think about the correctness contract carefully, because this determines the whole fix.

**Critical correctness analysis:**

The host passes a FULL replicated params blob to every rank. There is NO host-side grad all-reduce between steps. The in-kernel AdamW updates params in place. For `cross_rank_agree` (all 8 ranks same loss) AND `loss descends` consistently, **every rank's params must stay identical across steps**. That requires every rank to apply the IDENTICAL full param update each step → every rank must compute the IDENTICAL FULL gradient.

With genuine TP weight-sharding (each rank computes only its shard's dW), the grads differ per rank → params diverge → ranks disagree after step 1. The ONLY ways to keep params consistent:
1. Each rank computes the full grad (no sharding) — fully replicated.
